## Summary
Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation
- [ ] Automated repository checks pass.
- [ ] Token mint address has not been altered accidentally.
- [ ] Documentation links and artwork paths resolve.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, seed phrases, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Claims about on-chain status, audits, utility, partnerships, and listings have evidence.
- [ ] Risk disclosures remain accurate.
